_doc: Maintainer verification records for the pivots_brazil links (batch p2-G14-2): request URL, status, page title and a note per check, 2026-11-25/26 from a datacenter egress. Page bodies are not kept (victim lists, PEP names and bucket file names never enter the repository). 'link' and 'entity' name the pack link and the value the URL was built from; tests render them and compare with 'url'. V3LUM itself never requests these URLs.
